rounds.text: Energy Development Company Ltd is significantly under-appreciated by the market, trading at an attractive price-to-book ratio of 0.97x on a book value of ₹ 17.8 [E1]. The company is experiencing a powerful operational turnaround, highlighted by a massive 65% compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months [E16] and an 84% jump in compounded profit growth over the same period [E17]. This fundamental momentum is reinforced by a dramatic improvement in debtor days from 583 down to 47.4 days [E53]. Furthermore, the business is conservatively financed with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.21x [E34], having successfully reduced total borrowings down to ₹ 18.03 Cr [E35], which yields a strong positive operating cash flow of ₹ 7.71 Cr and free cash flow of ₹ 7.66 Cr in Mar 2026 [E32]. Conceded: the company carries contingent liabilities of Rs. 286 Cr [E56] and has delivered a low return on equity over recent periods [E55].
